title: Sustaining and Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Abacus Insights is transforming how data works for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
   

  

 We help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we’re tackling big challenges in an industry that’s ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it’s why we are leading the way.
   

  

 Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Join us and let’s build the future together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Site Reliability and Forward Deployed Engineer is an individual contributor who supports production operations, incident response, and post\-launch reliability across the Abacus Insights platform. Working with guidance from experienced engineers and technical leaders, this role builds practical skills in troubleshooting, automation, customer support, and reliable system operations.
   

  

**This Role Combines**
* Production operations and reliability engineering fundamentals
* Hands\-on technical troubleshooting during incidents and escalations
* Customer\-facing technical support for deployments and production issues
* Software development and automation to reduce manual operational work


 You will help investigate production issues involving AWS infrastructure, Databricks workloads, and data pipelines. You will partner with senior engineers, platform teams, and customer\-facing teams to resolve issues, improve operational documentation, and turn recurring problems into reusable solutions.
   

  

 You are expected to participate actively in incident response, debug systems using established tools and runbooks, and contribute code and documentation that improve reliability and operability.
   

  

 Success in this role is supported through structured onboarding covering the platform, production support processes, incident response, and customer context; pairing and mentorship from experienced SRE, platform, data, and engineering team members; progressive ownership, beginning with documented and well\-scoped tasks before moving to more complex incidents and customer engagements; and regular feedback focused on technical growth, operational judgment, communication, and automation skills.
   

  

**Your day to day**
* Participate in production incident triage, mitigation, recovery, and follow\-up activities under the guidance of experienced engineers.
* Contribute evidence, technical findings, and follow\-up actions to root cause analyses (RCAs).
* Investigate and resolve well\-scoped production defects and field\-reported issues, escalating complex or high\-risk problems appropriately.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Customer Success, and Support teams during customer\-impacting incidents and escalations.
* Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, monitoring, alerting, and operational checklists.
* Support customer deployments, integrations, and production troubleshooting alongside senior or customer\-facing engineers.
* Write and maintain Python scripts or small services that automate repeatable operational workflows, improve observability, and reduce manual toil.
* Use established tools and procedures to support AWS\- and Databricks\-based production systems, including basic performance, data quality, and job\-failure investigations.
* Document incident learnings and customer issues, and help convert recurring patterns into reusable tools, knowledge articles, and product improvement suggestions.
* Participate in an on\-call or shift\-based support rotation after completing the required onboarding and readiness training.


**What You Bring To The Team**
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in software engineering, site reliability engineering, technical support, production operations, data engineering, or a related field. Relevant internships, academic projects, or hands\-on technical training may be considered.
* Understanding of cloud computing and interest in supporting production systems in AWS.
* Basic Python programming skills and the ability to read, troubleshoot, and modify existing scripts or services.
* Familiarity with Linux command\-line tools, logs, APIs, or SQL\-based troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of incident response, root cause analysis, monitoring, alerting, and observability concepts.
* Awareness of distributed systems, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and Infrastructure as Code concepts.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to document findings and provide timely status updates.
* A structured troubleshooting mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to ask for help or escalate when appropriate.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks through resolution with coaching and guidance.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong interest in learning production reliability and customer\-facing engineering practices.
* Bachelors Degree in engineering or related field.


**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**
* Internship, project, or work experience in a cloud, data, DevOps, technical support, or production operations environment.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, data pipelines, or other data platforms and warehouses.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes or EKS, EMR, Lambda, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.
* Experience using ticketing, monitoring, logging, or incident management tools.
* Exposure to healthcare, regulated data, or security\-conscious environments.
* Experience participating in an on\-call, lab\-support, service\-desk, or operational support rotation.
* Customer\-facing, consulting, implementation, or technical communication experience.


**What You’ll Get In Return**
* Competitive Leave \& Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth\-focused environment – your development matters here

* Location: Pune, 5 Days from the office

title: Business Intelligence & Reporting Consultant
description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.
   

  

 Business Intelligence \& Reporting Consultant
   

  

 Oracle SQL / PostgreSQL \| Client\-facing designation: Technical Consultant
   

  

 Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-time (via SIG's Employer of Record in India)
   

  

 Experience: 4–7 years
   

  

 Fixed Base Compensation: ₹29\.5–₹33\.3 lakh per year
   

  

**About SIG**
 Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US\-based leader in higher\-education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernize the systems that run their institutions — student information, HR, and finance — through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM, and cybersecurity work.
   

  

 We are building our first engineering Center of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding\-team role. You will not be joining a large delivery pool with a fixed process; you will help set how this team builds.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a hands\-on SQL and reporting role for someone who enjoys working with complex data and transforming business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and data solutions.
   

  

 You will work across large Oracle and PostgreSQL environments, designing data models, building reporting solutions, and supporting data warehouses that enable institutional decision\-making. While the role includes client interaction, the primary focus is on data analysis, SQL development, and business intelligence.
   

  

 We are not looking for someone who has simply used SQL. We want a BI professional who can independently analyze complex schemas, build robust reporting solutions, and translate business requirements into trusted data products. Higher education experience is not required;
 **strong SQL, data modeling, and reporting expertise** 
 are.
   

  

**APIs Are the Core of This Work**
 If there is one thing to take from this description, it is this: your primary skill is working with APIs.
   

  

 Ellucian exposes a very large API surface across its student, HR, and finance platforms. A significant part of the job is knowing that catalog — reading a business requirement, working out which APIs actually serve that function, understanding what each one returns and what it does not, and then writing the code that meets the requirement. Nobody hands you a mapping from business need to endpoint. You build that understanding, and it becomes some of the most valuable knowledge you carry.
   

  

 The second half is API security. These APIs move student records, employee data, and financial transactions. You need to understand authentication and authorization flows, how tokens and scopes work, and how to request only the access an integration genuinely needs. Getting this wrong is not a bug — it is a data exposure.
   

  

*We are looking for depth here, not familiarity. Someone who has run a few SELECT statements will struggle. Someone who has written, tuned, and debugged complex SQL against real schemas and designed the models behind it will do well.*
**What You Will Do**
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries in Oracle and PostgreSQL.
* Translate reporting requirements into reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
* Design and maintain data models, data warehouses, and ETL/data integration processes.
* Develop BI solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar platforms.
* Validate and reconcile data across multiple systems and large relational datasets.
* Partner with clients and stakeholders to gather requirements, present solutions, and support delivery.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and solution quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4–7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, SQL development, reporting, data engineering, or related fields.
* Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization, performance tuning, indexing, and execution plans.
* Experience with Oracle SQL and/or PostgreSQL.
* Strong data modeling experience, including normalized (3NF) and dimensional/star schema design.
* Experience building or supporting data warehouses and ETL/data integration processes.
* Hands\-on experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar in a professional environment.
* Experience supporting ERP, SIS, HRMS, or Finance systems.
* Prior exposure to Higher Education technology or Ellucian solutions (Banner, Colleague, ODS, EDW) is a plus, but not required.


*What we need from you is the ability to absorb a new domain fast and start contributing inside two months.*
**Working Hours**
 Flexible schedule with a Tuesday \- Thursday overlap requirement of 3–4 hours with US Eastern morning, 2:00 \- 10:00 PM IST. Outside that overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in.
   

  

**Who Does Well Here**
* You are self\-driven. You unblock yourself, ask sharp questions, and do not wait to be assigned work.
* You are curious about the tools that make you faster, and you actually try them.
* You are comfortable being early. This team is being built now, and the process is not fully written.
* You can talk to a non\-technical client and explain what you built without making them feel lost.


*Strata Information Group is an equal opportunity employer.*
*The listed salary range for this position is indicative and subject to adjustment based on the candidate's unique skills and location. Final compensation will be determined through mutual agreement between the successful candidate and SIG.*
 SIG is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer

**Position Summary**
 The Engineering Manager will lead the India engineering team building PulseAI, Gruve's on\-premises, Kubernetes\-native GPU orchestration and AI inference platform. This is a hands\-on role: you will balance day\-to\-day delivery and people management with real technical involvement — reviewing designs and code, and unblocking engineers — while working closely with the Lead Architect / Product Owner to turn technical designs and JIRA backlogs into shipped, quality\-tested increments. You will also grow a high\-performing engineering team.

* Stay hands\-on — review designs, participate in architecture discussions, read and review code, and unblock engineers on FastAPI/PostgreSQL backend, React frontend, and RKE2/OpenShift deployment issues
* Translate technical design documents and JIRA stories into clear, sequenced execution plans for the India engineering team
* Recruit, mentor, and develop engineers; run performance conversations, set growth plans, and build a strong engineering culture within the team
* Coordinate closely with the external development vendor and internal architecture leadership to align delivery timelines, resolve cross\-team dependencies, and maintain quality standards
* Drive engineering best practices: code review discipline, CI/CD hygiene, test coverage, and consistent frontend routing and coding standards across the team
* Partner with QA to plan release readiness, support UAT cycles, and ensure milestone sign\-off criteria are met before delivery
* Manage risk and dependency tracking across concurrent workstreams (Model Deployment, Observability \& Metrics, Secrets Management, GPU Quota/Billing) and escalate blockers early
* Contribute to technical decision\-making on multi\-tenant isolation, GPU resource quota enforcement, and identity/SSO federation as the platform evolves
* Report on team velocity, delivery risk, and capacity to the Lead Architect / Product Owner and other stakeholders


**Basic Qualifications**
* Education: B.E / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline
* Experience: 10\-15 years in software engineering, with at least 2\-3 years in a engineering manager/ tech\-lead capacity leading a team of 5\-10 engineers
* Demonstrated hands\-on proficiency in at least one backend stack (Python/FastAPI or equivalent) and one frontend stack (React or equivalent), with the ability to review code and unblock engineers directly
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes\-native application development and deployment (RKE2, OpenShift, or vanilla K8s)
* Experience managing delivery for complex, multi\-service platforms (preferably virtualisation and control planes)
* Well versed with Agile methodology including sprint planning, estimation, prioritisation, governance and reporting
* Proven experience hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers, including performance management
* Comfort working across India/US team structures and coordinating with external delivery vendors or partners
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical design detail and delivery status for architecture and product stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with multi\-tenant SaaS architecture, RBAC models, and quota/billing systems will be an added advantage
* Experience with PostgreSQL schema\-per\-service architectures and event\-driven or workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n) will be an added advantage
* Exposure to Prometheus/Grafana\-based observability stacks will be an added advantage
* Prior experience managing or coordinating with offshore/nearshore development vendors will be an added advantage

title: Sr. Engineer - Cloud
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 We're hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain SOAR connectors that integrate third\-party security platforms with Falcon Fusion, and build/maintain platform services that provide core orchestration and workflow capabilities to all users of CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon Platform.
   

  

 Falcon Fusion – a core 'tier one' offering in our Flagship Platform, Falcon – is the Falcon product used by customers to automate breach remediations within their environments. It also serves as the runtime of apps built by our Foundry Module, and is 'dogfooded' by us internally to automate other workflows and speed up development. With these many varied uses, it can be responsible for processing anywhere from 500M to 10B\+ events/day and is in use by essentially every single customer of the Falcon Platform.
   

  

 This role is for an experienced backend microservices developer adept with cloud engineering principles. Your passion and meticulous attention to performance, reliability and scalability will be key ingredients to your success here at CrowdStrike.

* Build production\-grade SOAR connectors that integrate security platforms (SIEM, EDR, ticketing, IAM) with Falcon Fusion at scale, and contribute to the core platform services that power connector execution, authentication, and orchestration.

* Fluency in at least one programming language, preferably in Python or Go
* Proven expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs
* Experience developing applications using SQL and NoSQL databases
* Deep expertise in building distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs with a track record of making architectural decisions at scale
* Hands\-on experience in large\-scale (distributed) system architecture, high scalability and availability, and optimization
* Strong debugging skills
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
* Demonstrated track record of operational excellence when operating services that span many components across several geographical regions
* Strong communication skills; working collaboratively and confidently with internal stakeholders

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. title: AI & Agentic Systems Engineering, VP
description:
**Position Overview**
 Engineer is responsible for managing or performing work across multiple areas of the bank's overall IT Platform/Infrastructure including analysis, development, and administration. It may also involve taking functional oversight of engineering delivery for specific departments. Work includes:
   

  

* Planning and developing entire engineering solutions to accomplish business goals
* Building reliability and resiliency into solutions with appropriate testing and reviewing throughout the delivery lifecycle
* Ensuring maintainability and reusability of engineering solutions
* Ensuring solutions are well architected and can be integrated successfully into the end\-to\-end business process flow
* Reviewing engineering plans and quality to drive re\-use and improve engineering capability
* Participating in industry forums to drive adoption of innovative technologies, tools and solutions in the Bank.


**About DWS**
 At DWS, we’re capturing the opportunities of tomorrow. You can be part of a leading, client\-committed, global Asset Manager, making an impact on individuals, communities, and the world.
   

  

 Join us on our journey, and you can shape our transformation by working side by side with industry thought\-leaders and gaining new and diverse perspectives. You can share ideas and be yourself, whilst driving innovative and sustainable solutions that influence markets and behaviours for the better.
   

  

 Every day brings the opportunity to discover a new now, and here at DWS, you’ll be supported as you overcome challenges and reach your ambitions. This is your chance to lead an extraordinary career and invest in your future.
   

  

**Read More About DWS And Who We Are Here.**
 Our Team
   

  

 Chief Operating Office (COO) Customer Success Management (CSM) enables the successful delivery and adoption of strategic themes across DWS. The function acts as the link between business, technology, operations and enabling functions, ensuring that ideas translate into measurable business value. Through stakeholder engagement, governance, and execution support, COO CSM accelerates transformation, innovation, and operational excellence for DWS.
   

  

 COO CSM is a core pillar of DWS' target operating model, bringing together business, product, engineering and enabling functions to accelerate the path from opportunity identification to scalable business outcomes.
   

  

 The India\-based engineering team is our technology innovation and delivery hub supporting rapid prototyping, research and validation of emerging AI and modern technology solutions. Working closely with business, product and technology stakeholders, the team turns early\-stage ideas into reusable, scalable solutions that can progress from proof of concept to enterprise adoption.
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

 AI \& Agentic Systems Engineering
   

  

* Architect and deliver enterprise\-grade AI solutions using Generative AI, Large Language Models and agentic frameworks, including AI copilots, domain\-specific assistants and multi\-agent workflows. Apply tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel or equivalent frameworks where suitable.
* Design planning, orchestration, reviewer, evaluator and execution agents, with appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop controls, safety mechanisms and monitoring.
* Translate prioritized business and investment challenges into scalable technical architectures and production\-ready AI services.


 Generative AI, RAG \& AI Platform Engineering
   

  

* Develop LLM\-powered applications using leading commercial and open\-source models and platforms, such as Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Hugging Face or equivalent, applying prompt engineering, structured outputs, reasoning frameworks and autonomous workflows.
* Design retrieval\-augmented generation solutions using semantic and hybrid search, embeddings, enterprise knowledge bases, metadata enrichment, reranking and retrieval\-quality optimization. Use vector databases, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Azure AI Search or equivalent services where beneficial.
* Establish LLMOps capabilities covering prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, observability, performance and cost monitoring, testing, validation and responsible AI controls. Apply tools such as MLflow, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry or equivalent platforms where appropriate.


 Full\-Stack, Data \& Cloud Engineering
   

  

* Lead hands\-on development of modern React and TypeScript front ends and Python\- or Java\-based back\-end services, APIs and microservices, using frameworks such as FastAPI, Spring Boot or equivalent.
* Build reliable data and analytics solutions using BigQuery and PostgreSQL, supported by cloud\-native, event\-driven and distributed architectures.
* Embed engineering excellence through automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization, observability, monitoring, logging and site reliability practices, using Git, GitHub or Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and relevant testing frameworks.


 Machine Learning \& Financial Analytics
   

  

* Design predictive and analytical models, including classification, ranking, recommendation and forecasting solutions, using appropriate supervised and unsupervised learning methods and established Python ML libraries such as scikit\-learn, PyTorch or equivalent.
* Apply feature engineering, model explainability and robust validation to deliver transparent, decision\-relevant analytics, using tools such as SHAP or equivalent where appropriate.
* Bring practical understanding of asset management, investment products and performance and risk measures to the design of relevant solutions.


 Technical Leadership \& Collaboration
   

  

* Define technical strategy, architecture and reusable engineering patterns for AI\-powered products and platforms, while guiding prototypes from proof of concept to enterprise deployment.
* Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, use case owners and control functions to align priorities, manage trade\-offs and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Mentor engineers, strengthen engineering standards and communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.


 Your Skills \& Experience:
   

  

* Extensive hands\-on software engineering experience, including the design and delivery of enterprise\-scale distributed applications and production\-grade AI or Generative AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in ReactJS and TypeScript, combined with strong Python or Java engineering skills and practical experience with API, microservices and asynchronous application design; experience with FastAPI, Spring Boot or comparable frameworks is beneficial.
* Strong experience with BigQuery and PostgreSQL, cloud\-native architectures, Git\-based development, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, observability and automated testing; practical knowledge of GitHub or Azure DevOps, Terraform and OpenTelemetry is beneficial.
* Practical expertise in LLM applications, AI agents, RAG architectures, vector databases, semantic or hybrid search, model evaluation and LLMOps, with hands\-on experience in relevant orchestration, evaluation and observability tools.
* Solid grounding in machine learning, feature engineering, model explainability and analytical modelling, using relevant Python ML libraries.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment products is highly desirable, with experience in asset management, ETFs or mutual funds and knowledge of key investment performance and risk metrics, including Sharpe Ratio, Information Ratio, Sortino Ratio, Alpha, Beta and Tracking Error.
* Strong engineering mindset and ownership mentality, with sound judgement and the ability to structure ambiguity, solve complex problems, make pragmatic technical decisions and balance delivery speed, quality, risk, maintainability and long\-term scalability.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand business needs, translate them into clear technical choices, manage expectations, influence decisions and build trusted relationships across business, product, technology and control functions.

title: Ontologies & Knowledge Graphs (Agentic AI, Surrogates, Physical AI)
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**AI Full Stack Engineer, Ontologies \& Knowledge Graphs (Agentic AI, Surrogates, Physical AI)** 
 —
   

  

**Experience: 6\+yrs**
**Job Location : Pune**
***Summary** 
 :* 
 Makes our simulation products AI\-accessible. Our products have rich programmatic surfaces — scripting APIs, file formats, data structures, workflow logic — that are powerful but not designed for AI consumption. This engineer defines the ontology schema that describes those surfaces, builds the knowledge graphs on top of them, and wraps them as structured, typed interfaces that AI agents can discover and invoke.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and maintain ontology schemas describing product capabilities, entities, and relationships
* Build and maintain knowledge graphs over product documentation, APIs, and simulation data
* Build structured tool interfaces exposing product capabilities to AI systems
* Write connectors to product APIs, parsers, and data access layers
* Implement retrieval and context layers over product knowledge
* Work with domain engineers to translate simulation workflows into discrete, callable operations
* Review product ontologies for agentic\-readiness across 2–3 products


**Skills We Need**
* Strong Python; experience building and consuming REST APIs
* Familiarity with graph databases and/or ontology/semantic modeling (RDF, OWL, property graphs, or equivalent)
* Experience with at least one agent framework (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar)
* Understanding of how LLMs consume context and call tools
* Comfortable working within unfamiliar or undocumented codebases
* Systems thinker — able to decompose a complex legacy workflow into discrete, callable steps


**Nice To Have**
 Vector databases; agent\-tool interface development; parsing structured file formats; exposure to CAE/FEA/CFD, surrogate modeling, or physical AI.
   

  

*Deliberately not required:* 
 Deep simulation domain knowledge — domain engineers provide that. No PhD or ML research background.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 The
 **Lead Forward Deployed Engineer** 
 operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands\-on, customer\-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Onboarding \& Data Integration
   

  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end\-to\-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline \& API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3\-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling \& Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de\-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.


 Data Quality \& Validation
   

  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision\-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.


 Dashboards, Remediation \& Workflows
   

  

* Analytics \& Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board\-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.


 Product \& Engineering Feedback Loop
   

  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation\-driven action.


 Required Qualifications:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer\-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands\-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain \& Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands\-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client\-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large\-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high\-impact, fast\-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

title: Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1\) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end\-to\-end, and (2\) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
   

  

 You will work across compute and cloud\-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU\-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer\-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain product\-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python\-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code\-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer\-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes\-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high\-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer\-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time\-to\-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance


**What We Need To See**
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* At least 5\+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C\+\+ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional\-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on\-prem or CSP environments
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes\-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control\-plane/data\-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

title: Integration Analyst
description:
**Who We Are:** 




 Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.
 



  





  





**Integrations Analyst** 




*The largest and most impactful transformation in our 100\+ year history is currently underway at New Balance. We have started a digital revolution, investing in exciting new capabilities for both our customers and associates. One of our primary initiatives is the reimagining of our global integration platforms that will unite our core business processes, aligning the demands of our channel sales with the real\-time status of our supply chain. By unlocking new support functionality and consumer insights, this platform will allow us to anticipate and better serve the needs of our customers. We’re seeking agile thinkers who can quickly adapt in a collaborative, high\-performance culture. Are you ready to join the revolution?* 




**General Summary:** 




 As a Configuration Analyst for integrations, you will build, configure, and maintain EDI and non\-EDI integration solutions on the Partner LINQ platform, contributing to New Balance’s global digital transformation. You will play a central role in migrating legacy IBM Sterling EDI and Cleo Harmony MFT integrations onto Partner LINQ — configuring mappings, orchestration flows, and business rules — helping drive New Balance to be a Top 3 Global Athletic Brand through responsive, standardized integration workflows that support consistent business growth, expand market share, and strengthen brand equity and reputation
 



**MAJOR ACCOUNTABILTIES:** 



* Create and configure mappings, process/orchestration flows, business rules, cross\-reference schemas, and lookups within the PartnerLinQ Design Studio to meet business requirements.
* Convert existing IBM Sterling maps and Cleo MFT flows to PartnerLinQ, leveraging AI Mapping Agent / template\-based tooling to standardize and optimize designs for reuse.
* Perform unit testing on all integrations, coordinate with end\-system teams, and support SIT and UAT cycles, producing test result reports against production sample files.
* Manage controlled promotion of tested configurations (mappings, alerts, dashboards, partnerships) from lower to production environments, validating dependencies and completeness before migration.
* Support white\-glove partner onboarding: gather EDI specifications, IDs, and connection details; build mapping templates; run connection and business\-rule testing.
* Support production deployments and provide post\-go\-live hypercare, troubleshooting transaction and mapping issues and creating SOPs / runbooks.
* Follow approved integration governance patterns, intake, documentation standards, and SLA checkpoints for all net\-new and migrated integrations.



**REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:** 




 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3 to 5 years of Hands\-on experience configuring EDI/B2B integrations, ideally on PartnerLinQ or a comparable platform (IBM Sterling, Cleo), preferred.
 


* Working knowledge of EDI standards — X12, EDIFACT/EANCOM — and common transaction sets (850, 855, 856, 810, 820, 846\)
* Mapping to/from canonical and flat\-file formats
* Data transformation using XML, JSON, flat files, and XSLT
* Target systems such as D365 F\&O, SAP, SQL
* Transport protocols — AS2, SFTP, API/VAN
* PartnerLinQ Business Rule Engine, Cross Reference Schema, and Artifacts Migration (plus)
* Azure Integration Services (AIS) exposure (plus)
* Git / Azure DevOps (plus)
* Sterling→PLQ or Cleo→PLQ/AIS migration experience (nice to have)
* Solid analytical, documentation, and troubleshooting skills; ability to translate business requirements into detailed configurations. Good communication, critical thinking, and collaboration skills.
* undefined



  





  





**Flexible Work Schedule**




 For decades we have fostered a unique culture founded on our values with a particular focus on in\-person teamwork and collaboration. Our hybrid model encourages rich in\-person experiences, showcasing our commitment to teamwork and connection, while providing high levels of flexibility to associates. North American office\-based associates are expected to come into the office on Wednesdays, with other occasional in\-office days for in\-person meetings and events as needed.  Role

 Bachelor's degree
   

  

 Solid foundation in Computer Science fundamentals
   

  

 Strong leadership and collaboration skills

 Experience building applications using Java and PCF

 You are passionate about the art of delivering the highest quality software to customers

**Nice To Have**
 Experience working within the commercial card space or corporate banking
   

  

 Strong ability to multi\-task, organize, manage, and implement complex projects whether directly or through supervision
   

  

 Operates with minimal supervision and able to make informed, well\-reasoned decisions independently
   

  

 Thrives in an environment that is fast\-paced, rapidly changing, and customer\-oriented
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

**Company Overview**

Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.
   

  

 Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.
   

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
**Context**
 You will be part of the Professional Services Team whose mission is to successfully deliver our unique and configurable solution to customers and support our Partner community with high quality standards and a strong commitment to excellence and efficiency. Our team is very hands\-on with a strong mindset of problem\-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long\-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end\-to\-end spend management data solutions.
   

  

**Role**
 We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the
 **most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds** 
 across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
   

  

 You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).
   

  

 This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.
   

  

**What You Will Do With Us**
**Integration Design \& Implementation**
* End‑to‑End Integration Design: Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Hands‑On Build: Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* Standards \& Reuse: Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* Performance \& Robustness: Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* Troubleshooting \& Debugging: Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**
* Work with Functional \& Technical Teams: Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* Customer Technical Workshops: Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* R\&D Feedback: Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* Pre‑Sales Support: Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.


**Delivery Excellence**
* Technical Specifications: Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* Quality Assurance: Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* Risk \& Issue Management: Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* Lifecycle Support: Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.


**Partner \& Internal Enablement**
* Technical Mentor: Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* Partner Guidance: Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* Knowledge Assets: Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.


**YOUR PROFILE**
 If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.
* Demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve most the complex integration problems across applications, middleware, and databases.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .
* Comfortable working in a customer‑facing Professional Services or consulting environment, managing multiple workstreams and priorities.
* A Bachelor's (BS) degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field or foreign equivalent is required.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed (\~10–20%, depending on project needs).


**Preferred Skills**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Software Engineering Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction. If you thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment, value creativity and technical excellence, and are eager to make a meaningful impact, this is the role for you.
   

  

 The Services global product team is seeking a Manager, Software Engineering to accelerate the development of Analytics \& AI solutions within the Data Analytics and AI product suite. The goal of this team is to build AI products that drive smarter decisions and better outcomes for customers, applying AI responsibly, and leveraging in\-house and 3rd party assets and capabilities effectively to maximize ROI for the program.
   

  

 Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
 As a Manager, Software Engineering, you will:
   

  

 Lead strategic technical direction for applications, architectures, and development processes.
   

  

 Lead and push the boundaries of analytics and powerful, scalable applications
   

  

 Act as a contributor to product implementation while empowering your team
   

  

 Champion innovation by exploring and adopting new technologies and methodologies.
   

  

 Lead with an agile mindset, adapting to changes quickly and guiding your team to pivot when needed.
   

  

 Coach, mentor, and develop a cross\-functional engineering team to deliver high\-quality solutions and well\-tested code
   

  

 Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
   

  

 Collaborate across teams and business units to solve complex technical problems and ensure alignment.
   

  

 Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to define roadmaps, scope features, and plan releases.
   

  

 Ensure projects meet customer demands while scaling platform solutions for future growth.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate Qualifications**
 10\+ years of engineering experience in an agile production environment.
   

  

 Experience leading the design and implementation of complex features in full\-stack applications.
   

  

 Proficiency with object\-oriented languages, preferably Java/ Spring, alternatively C\#
   

  

 Proficiency with modern front\-end frameworks, preferably React with Redux, Typescript.
   

  

 Fluent in the use of Git, Jenkins.
   

  

 Solid experience with RESTful APIs and JSON/SOAP based API.
   

  

 Solid experience with SQL, Multi\-threading, Message Queuing.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Python or Scala is preferred, as well as expertise in Hadoop platforms and related tools.
   

  

 Experience in building and deploying production\-level data\-driven applications and data processing, workflows/pipelines and/or implementing machine learning systems at scale in Java, Scala, or Python and deliver analytics involving all phases.
   

  

 Data engineering or data science background with strong understanding of data pipelines, architecture, infrastructure, and management.
   

  

**Desirable Capabilities**
 Hands on experience of cloud native development using microservices.
   

  

 Hands on experience on Kafka, Zookeeper.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise application security protocols and concepts.
   

  

 Expertise with automated E2E and unit testing frameworks.
   

  

 Knowledge of Splunk or other alerting and monitoring solutions.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
 Strong technologist eager to learn new technologies and frameworks.
   

  

 Experience coaching and mentoring junior teammates.
   

  

 Customer\-centric development approach
   

  

 Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving
   

  

 Ability to identify and implement improvements to team development processes
   

  

 Strong collaboration skills with experience collaborating across many people, roles, and geographies
   

  

 Motivation, creativity, self\-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams
   

  

 Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field
   

  

 Strong written and verbal English communication skills
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Oracle BRM Billing Service Lead - Pune
description:
**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle BRM Billing professional to take end\-to\-end operational ownership of Oracle Billing and Revenue Management (BRM) services. This role is focused on Application Operations and Service Management, ensuring the availability, stability, performance, resilience and continual improvement of business\-critical telecom billing platforms. The successful candidate will lead major incident recovery, service transitions, operational readiness, automation initiatives, billing assurance activities and stakeholder engagement, while driving Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and AI\-driven optimisation across billing operations. Based in Pune, this opportunity is ideal for an individual with deep telecom BSS expertise and extensive hands\-on Oracle BRM production support experience.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the operational health, availability, resilience, performance and supportability of Oracle BRM billing services
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for complex billing, rating, invoicing, payment, adjustment, discount and collections issues
* Govern business\-critical billing calendars, bill runs, validation activities, reconciliations and exception management processes.
* Lead major incident recovery for priority incidents, coordinate cross\-functional troubleshooting and communicate business impacts effectively.
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, known error management and elimination of recurring service issues.
* Ensure adherence to SLA and KPI commitments across Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request processes
* Lead service transition activities including due diligence, knowledge transfer, shadowing, operational readiness and service stabilisation
* Oversee rating file processing, CDR pipeline health, billing execution, invoice generation, payment and collections flows.
* Drive reconciliation activities across CRM, mediation, BRM, invoicing and reporting systems to identify and resolve discrepancies.
* Deliver automation solutions using Shell scripting and PL/SQL to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Build proactive observability capabilities through enterprise monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace, Kibana and Datadog.
* Partner with business, infrastructure, middleware, database, CRM, mediation and vendor teams to deliver reliable services
* Mentor support teams, strengthen knowledge management practices and support succession and cross\-skilling initiatives


**Who You Are**
* Extensive Telecom IT or BSS experience with significant hands\-on Oracle BRM production support expertise.
* Strong understanding of Oracle BRM architecture, administration and operational support.
* Deep domain knowledge of telecom billing, rating, charging, invoicing, payments, taxation, collections and revenue assurance.
* Proven experience managing critical billing operations and complex production incidents.
* Strong expertise in Unix/Linux, Shell scripting, Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and AI\-driven operational optimisation initiatives.
* Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog or Zabbix.
* Familiarity with PDC, ECE, OCOMC, BI Publisher, WebLogic, Oracle databases and Control\-M is advantageous.
* Understanding of cloud platforms, container technologies, Kubernetes and CI/CD practices is desirable.
* Experience leading service transitions, operational readiness and stabilisation activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical and leadership capabilities
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. ITIL certification is desirable.

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Opportunity to lead business\-critical telecom billing operations within a global technology environment.
* Exposure to large\-scale Oracle BRM platforms and complex end\-to\-end BSS ecosystems.
* Involvement in service transformation, automation, observability and reliability engineering initiatives.
* Collaboration with global stakeholders, technology teams and strategic partners
* Ability to influence operational strategy, service governance and continual improvement programmes


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced service ownership and governance practices for large\-scale telecom billing platforms.
* Site Reliability Engineering methodologies applied to mission\-critical business applications.
* AI\-driven operational optimisation and service improvement techniques.
* Enterprise observability, monitoring and proactive service management practices
* Service transition, operational readiness and managed\-service leadership capabilities.


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* This role combines deep platform engineering with hands\-on security ownership. You will shape how NKP delivers secure, compliant, and production\-grade Kubernetes \+ storage capabilities at enterprise scale.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis.  Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.

* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).

**Eligibility Criteria**

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sub Value Stream Tech Lead.**
**The Opportunity**
 Group Functions Technology is a Global Function encompassing platforms that are vital to the bank’s operation. Our mission is to “ Enable, Protect and Delight ” HSBC’s global businesses.
   

  

 Within Group Functions Technology, Risk and Compliance Technology is building a real\-time decisioning capability that can evaluate transaction events, coordinate multiple detection techniques and select the right preventative action within strict sub\-second latency budgets. Sitting above HSBC's real\-time data feeds, the platform will orchestrate rules, machine\-learning models, graph capabilities, foundation models and approved bounded agent functions across real\-time, near\-real\-time and asynchronous execution tiers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define and build HSBC’s real\-time decisioning and model\-orchestration platform for financial crime prevention
* Translate financial\-crime policy and customer\-outcome requirements into deterministic, explainable and auditable technical decisions
* Architect a resilient runtime that selects execution capabilities, sequences and parallelism and calibrates outputs into a traceable decision
* Engineer low\-latency, highly available distributed systems with explicit time budgets, fallbacks, circuit breakers and safe degradation
* Own the technical direction across model execution orchestration and decision strategy while keeping them as clearly separated platform capabilities
* Emphasize Java and Python, event\-driven architecture, Kafka or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes and cloud\-native engineering.
* Champion AI\-enabled engineering and an agentic SDLC by embedding approved AI coding assistants and autonomous engineering agents with human oversight, traceability and governance
* Partner with CIOs, business leaders, architects, model owners, risk management, cybersecurity and engineering teams across Risk and Compliance to deliver safely at scale
* Mentor engineer teams and share knowledge through production code, design reviews, reference implementations and cross\-team technical standards.
* Automate delivery and operation from the outset, including CI/CD, policy and model versioning, performance testing, failure injection, decision replay, rollback and controlled production releases.


**What you will need to succeed in the role** 
 :
   

  

* As a Senior Technologist you should have hands\-on engineering experience delivering critical production code and reference implementations
* Demonstrate deep mastery of Java or Python including high\-performance services, concurrency and distributed workflow or orchestration engines
* Proven experience in designing low\-latency distributed systems including API and event contracts, schema evolution, idempotency, back\-pressure, load shedding, timeouts, retries and graceful degradation
* Experience in cloud native engineering, Kakfa or equivalent streaming platforms, containers, Kubernetes
* Experienced and comfortable operating in a highly regulated environment and the security and control framework this necessitates.
* Ability to communicate technology ideas clearly to business / senior leaders
* Ability to build trusted relationship \& collaborate well beyond their immediate team (including model risk owners, architecture / platform / security / engineering teams, cross ‑ organization and at times external stakeholders / industry)
