description:
For more than 40 years, Accelya has been the industry’s partner for change, simplifying airline financial and commercial processes and empowering the air transport community to take better control of the future. Whether partnering with IATA on industry\-wide initiatives or enabling digital transformation to simplify airline processes, Accelya drives the airline industry forward and proudly puts control back in the hands of airlines so they can move further, faster.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer with 5\+ years of experience building full\-stack solutions using .NET Core for backend services and TypeScript with ReactJS/Next.js for modern web frontends, paired with deep expertise in AWS technologies — including DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, and S3\. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of leading projects, actively contributing to sprint design, and mentoring team members, with a passion for delivering high\-quality, scalable, and efficient software across the full stack.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Software Development**
 Design, code, and implement full\-stack software solutions using .NET Core (backend/APIs) and TypeScript\-based ReactJS/Next.js (frontend). Develop high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable applications end to end.
   

  

**Technical Design and Architecture**
 Collaborate with architects and senior engineers to define technical vision, system architecture, and integration of AWS services and frontend frameworks. Contribute to the design of software components, ensuring scalability, performance, and adherence to best practices — including serverless\-first patterns where appropriate.
   

  

**AWS Services Integration**
 Utilize AWS services such as DynamoDB, EventBridge, Lambda, S3, and others to design and implement robust, efficient, serverless solutions. Integrate applications with these services, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

**Frontend Engineering**
 Build responsive, performant, type\-safe user interfaces with TypeScript, React, and Next.js (SSR/SSG, App Router, API routes). Ensure clean integration between frontend applications and .NET Core/serverless backends.
   

  

**Database Integration**
 Design and optimize database schemas and queries for efficient data storage and retrieval in DynamoDB. Integrate and synchronize data across databases and AWS services.
   

  

**Testing and Quality Assurance**
 Write unit and integration tests, conduct code reviews, and enforce coding standards across backend and frontend code. Build and maintain automated test coverage. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and resolve issues.
   

  

**CI/CD and DevOps**
 Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment across environments, supporting serverless deployments (Lambda, S3, CloudFormation/CDK/Serverless Framework).
   

  

**Continuous Improvement**
 Stay current with .NET Core, TypeScript, React/Next.js, AWS, and AI\-assisted development tooling. Identify opportunities for process improvement, code optimization, and enhanced developer workflows — including adopting AI coding assistants to boost team velocity and code quality.
   

  

**Collaboration and Leadership**
 Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to align development efforts with requirements. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers across both backend and frontend disciplines.
   

  

**Troubleshooting and Support**
 Investigate and resolve complex technical issues in development and production. Support end users/clients to ensure smooth operation of applications.
   

  

**What do you need to know?**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on software development experience with .NET Core, with strong AWS\-based project experience.
* Working experience with TypeScript, ReactJS, and Next.js for building production frontend applications.
* Expertise in AWS services, including DynamoDB, EventBridge, and Lambda; solid understanding of S3 and serverless architectures.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitLab CI.
* Proven track record of leading projects and delivering high\-quality software solutions end to end.
* Deep understanding of software development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across full\-stack applications.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills across distributed, serverless systems.
* Excellent mentoring and leadership abilities, with a passion for developing junior engineers.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) and experience working in an Agile environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.


**Good to have**
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) to accelerate coding, code review, and testing workflows.

* Efficient, optimized database design and development with high\-performance queries.
* Successful development and management of ETL processes, ensuring smooth data flow between systems.
* High availability of data with minimal downtime through effective backup, recovery, and replication strategies.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud\-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
   

  

 Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co\-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
   

  

 Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Manager, Engineering reports to the Director, Engineering and leads a team of software engineers who build and sustain the products Armor’s customers depend on. This is a hands\-on leadership position: the manager writes production code, opens and reviews pull requests, and ships alongside the engineers they lead. The role exercises independent judgment and discretion in setting technical direction, making architecture decisions, prioritizing defects and feature work, directing incident response, and developing engineering talent. Armor is looking for a technical leader with a track record of building and shipping high\-quality software with AI\-assisted development tools, and with the engineering judgment to raise the bar on architecture, delivery speed, and engineering ownership. This is a full\-time in\-office role based in Pune, India; on\-site presence five days a week is required.
   

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (Additional duties may be assigned as required)**
* Lead and manage a high\-performing AI\-native software engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, and hands\-on guidance while building a culture of engineering ownership.
* Contribute directly to architecture, design, code reviews, and implementation of complex software, working in the repository alongside the team rather than reviewing from a distance.
* Own day\-to\-day delivery for the assigned product areas, including feature work, defect triage, regression prevention, and customer escalations, and keep the Director, Engineering current on status and risk.
* Drive end\-to\-end engineering execution with minimal reliance on product management, translating business objectives into working software.
* Execute release management discipline set by the Director, Engineering, including change windows, rollback criteria, and release readiness for the team’s work.
* Put AI\-assisted development tools into daily engineering practice, measure the effect on delivery speed and quality, and hold the team to production\-grade standards for AI\-generated code.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, developer tools, and cloud technologies, balancing rapid experimentation against production\-grade engineering discipline.
* Hire and build the team, including defining the technical hiring bar, running interview loops, and onboarding new engineers.
* Manage relationships with third\-party technology vendors by evaluating platform usage, monitoring cost and performance, assessing alternatives, and providing technical recommendations that support renewals, negotiations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions.
* Collaborate with global and regional teams, ensuring clear communication, knowledge sharing, and alignment across distributed engineering teams.
* Manage team performance through regular one\-on\-one meetings, goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and career development planning.
* Serve as the escalation point for production incidents and customer\-impacting issues, coordinating rapid response, running post\-incident reviews, and feeding the findings back into engineering practice.


**Required Skills**
* Demonstrated track record of shipping production software that customers depend on. Show us the work; we do not screen on years on a resume.
* Experience leading or managing software engineers, including performance management, coaching, and career development.
* Hands\-on production experience delivering software with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent.
* Strong frontend and backend development skills using technologies such as React, TypeScript, C\#, Node.js, Python, or Go, with demonstrated ability to contribute directly to code, architecture, and technical problem\-solving.
* Excellent software architecture skills, with the ability to set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, and promote practices that improve security, quality, maintainability, and scalability.
* Production experience with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform, including deploying and operating applications in cloud environments.
* Proven ability to combine hands\-on development with leadership responsibilities without sacrificing either.
* Strong defect management and quality engineering instincts, including the ability to distinguish a regression from a customer\-found defect from a product gap, and to treat each one differently.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes for scalable application delivery.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Strong experience with relational, non\-relational, and AI\-enabled data platforms, including SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases, data modeling, performance tuning, and scalable data architectures for AI applications.
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, providing both technical advice and strategic direction to help customers reach their goals.
* Git proficiency including branching strategies, code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline integration.
* Understanding of AI/LLM security risks including prompt injection, data leakage, and model limitations.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy and security implications.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed teams and time zones.
* Preferred: bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience.
* Preferred: experience with virtualization, infrastructure, and data protection technologies such as VMware vSphere, Proxmox, NSX\-T, FortiMonitor, Zerto, and Rubrik.
* Preferred: cybersecurity background covering XDR, MDR, SIEM, SOC tooling, endpoint detection and response, threat detection, incident response, and security monitoring.


**WHY ARMOR**
 Join Armor if you want to be part of a company that is redefining cybersecurity. Here, you will have the opportunity to shape the future, disrupt the status quo, and be a part of a team that celebrates energy, passion, and fresh thinking. We are not looking for someone who simply fills a role – we want talent who will help us write the next chapter of our growth story.
   

  

**ARMOR CORE VALUES**
* Commitment to Growth: A growth mindset that encourages continuous learning and improvement with adaptability in the face of challenges.
* Integrity Always: Sustain trust through transparency \+ honesty in all actions and interactions regardless of circumstances.
* Empathy In Action: Active understanding, compassion and support to the needs of others through genuine connection.
* Immediate Impact: Taking initiative with swift, informed actions to deliver positive outcomes.
* Follow\-Through: Dedication to delivering finished results with attention to quality and detail to achieve the desired outcomes.


**WORK ENVIRONMENT**
 The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate. The work environment can be either in an office setting or remotely from anywhere.

title: SCT-Tech Enablement-Digital supply chain lead-FDE-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**SCT\-Tech Enablement \- Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Supply Chain Lead (FDE) with 9–12 years of experience to join our growing Digital Supply Chain Team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both front\-end and back\-end layers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative digital solutions that drive business value and enhance user experiences.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies.
* Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Develop robust server\-side applications, APIs, and microservices using technologies such as Node.js, .NET, Java, or Python.
* Design and optimize relational and non\-relational databases to ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity.
* Integrate applications with internal and external systems through RESTful APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions to ensure adherence to best practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across development, testing, and production environments.
* Implement security, performance optimization, and monitoring practices across the application landscape.
* Contribute to CI/CD implementation, DevOps practices, and cloud\-native development initiatives.
* Mentor junior developers and support knowledge\-sharing across teams.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 6–10 years of hands\-on experience in full\-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js and Microsoft 365 technologies like PowerApps.
* Experience in back\-end development using one or more technologies such as Node.js, .NET Core, Java Spring Boot, or Python.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and API integration patterns.
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with version control systems such as Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Experience in development of Responsive UI components for Agentic AI / RAG based applications
* Should be able to Work back with data engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to integrate LLM and agentic frameworks (like LangChain or FastAPI backends)
* Experience with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Exposure to serverless architectures and event\-driven application design.
* Experience working with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar deployment tools.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test\-driven development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth, OpenID Connect, or SAML.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled development tools and modern engineering productivity practices.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and contribute to technical standards and reusable frameworks.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: SAP CDS ABAP Consultant
description:
**About InvenioLSI**
 The largest independent global SAP solutions provider serving the public sector as well as offering specialist skills in media and entertainment. We bring deep expertise combined with advanced technologies to enable organizations to modernize so they can run at the speed of today’s business. We know how to navigate the extraordinary complexities of international businesses and public sector organizations, working with stakeholders to drive change and create agile organizations of tomorrow using the technologies of today. Learn more at www.invenioLSI.com.
   

  

 Job Summary: \-
   

  

 We are seeking a technically proficient SAP CDS (Core Data Services) Analytics Senior Developer to join our analytics and technology team. This role involves designing, developing, and optimizing CDS views and analytics models within SAP environments, specifically tailored for enterprise\-level data management and reporting solutions. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with SAP HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, and S/4HANA, and will be responsible for delivering high\-performance data models and analytics solutions
   

  

 SAP Skills: \-
   

  

* Proficiency in developing CDS views with deep knowledge of SQL scripting and SAP HANA modeling.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and OData services.
* Strong understanding of SAP HANA architecture, performance tuning, and data management techniques.
* Familiarity with ABAP programming and SAP HANA SQL Script


 Responsibilities: \-
   

  

* CDS View Development:
* Design and develop complex CDS views for advanced data modeling and analytics within the SAP ecosystem.
* Implement data models that meet business requirements, ensuring high performance and scalability in large\-scale enterprise environments.
* Utilize annotations and associations to enhance CDS views, enabling efficient querying and reporting.
* SAP Analytics Integration:
* Integrate CDS views with SAP BW/4HANA, SAP S/4HANA, and other SAP modules, ensuring seamless data flow and consistency across the enterprise.
* Develop and optimize OData services for consumption by SAP Fiori applications and other reporting tools.
* Work closely with SAP functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions using SAP CDS.
* Performance Tuning and Optimization:
* Conduct performance analysis and optimization of CDS views to minimize data retrieval times and enhance user experience.
* Implement best practices in SQL scripting, indexing, and data partitioning to improve the efficiency of SAP HANA\-based models.
* Monitor and troubleshoot performance issues in CDS views and associated analytics applications.
* Data Management and Governance:
* Ensure data integrity and quality by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and transformation processes within CDS views.
* Develop and enforce data governance policies, ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data architects and governance teams to maintain accurate data lineage and metadata.
* Technical Leadership and Collaboration:
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior developers, guiding them in the development of CDS views and SAP analytics solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including SAP BASIS, functional consultants, and business analysts to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
* Stay current with SAP advancements, continuously improving the technical capabilities of the team by integrating new features and best practices.
* Documentation and Best Practices:
* Develop comprehensive documentation for CDS views, including data models, dependencies, and performance tuning techniques.
* Establish and maintain coding standards, ensuring that all developments are aligned with SAP best practices and organizational guidelines.
* Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure high\-quality deliverables.


 Qualification/Education Requirements: \-
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree IT or equivalent 3\-6 years of experience in one or more SAP modules.
* SAP Certified Application Associate \- SAP BW/4HANA \& SAP HANA is preferred.
* Exposure to other SAP modules and integration points.
* Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques.
* Ready to work in rotational shifts timings.


 Business Skills: \-
   

  

* Excellent oral and written communication skills, the ability to communicate with others clearly and concisely.
* Experience with Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio (optional).
* Understand business processes for focus areas or modules.
* Ability to do research and perform detailed tasks.
* Strong analytical skills.


 Consulting Skills: \-
   

  

* Aptitude for working in a team environment; problem\-solving skills, creative thinking, communicating clearly and empathetically, strong time management, and ability to collaborate with all levels of staff.
* Learn/understand consulting “soft” skills necessary on engagements, as well as with team collaborative initiatives.

**Project Role :** 
 Data Architect

 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 Senior Engineer role in Knowledge Engineering focused on designing, building, and leading significant workstreams for enterprise\-scale Knowledge Graph, semantic layer, ontology, and AI knowledge solutions on Microsoft Azure. In this role, the successful candidate leads a substantial knowledge engineering scope within a large program, translates real\-world business problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, guides technical direction, and contributes to thought leadership, reusable assets, and delivery standards. The role must bring relevant industry experience across domains such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, applying semantic AI, knowledge graphs, LLM grounding, data pipelines, and cloud\-native engineering patterns to deliver measurable client value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Engineer Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions using services such as Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.
   

  

 Build graph ingestion pipelines, semantic data products, vector integrations, LLM grounding layers, APIs, and governed access patterns on Azure while improving performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
   

  

 Lead the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform client data architecture within a large program scope.
   

  

 Direct the design, development, and implementation of AI, semantic layer, ontology, taxonomy, schema, graph modeling, and knowledge curation solutions, ensuring all components work together seamlessly.
   

  

 Work with project leaders, delivery leads, client stakeholders, architects, data engineers, AI engineers, product teams, and domain SMEs to create standout graph\-powered data and AI offerings.
   

  

 Develop strong client relationships, earn trust as a key advisor, and explain the business value of semantic layer, ontology, and knowledge graph solutions.
   

  

 Make the business case for the recommended semantic layer solution and contribute meaningfully to sales, pre\-sales, estimation, proposal inputs, and solution shaping activities.
   

  

 Provide thought leadership on technology trends, innovation opportunities, limitations, risks, delivery concerns, and practical adoption of knowledge graphs, semantic AI, LLM grounding, RAG, and agentic systems.
   

  

 Design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, schemas, standards, and reusable engineering patterns, while guiding teams on data model quality and implementation methods.
   

  

 Lead a team or workstream within a larger program, mentor engineers, review design/code/configuration, and guide adoption of new methodologies, model building techniques, and algorithms.
   

  

 Collaborate across business and technical teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery for the assigned scope and demonstrate value to business and technology stakeholders.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience with Knowledge Graph technologies such as RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL, OWL, graph query languages, schema design, ontology management, and KG curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience in schema design, ontology management, semantic modeling, taxonomy management, metadata management, and knowledge graph curation.
   

  

 Minimum 3 years of experience designing and developing Knowledge Graph solutions and graph\-based ML models across functional and technical workstreams.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience implementing end\-to\-end data pipelines for AI applications, especially LLM\-enabled or enterprise knowledge applications, with hands\-on design and configuration.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience with relational databases, object stores, graph databases such as Stardog, Neo4j, Amazon Neptune or equivalent, and vector databases.
   

  

 Minimum 2 years of experience leading a team or workstream within a larger program.
   

  

 Experience collaborating with engineering, research, product, domain, client\-facing, and cross\-functional teams across multiple time zones.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience building Azure\-based knowledge engineering solutions with Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse/Fabric, Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Microsoft Purview, Entra ID, APIs, and Azure Monitor.
   

  

 Strong Python experience with frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, PySpark, SQL, SPARQL, SHACL, Apache Airflow, Apache NiFi, and ETL/ELT pipeline tooling.
   

  

 Practical knowledge of NLP and search techniques including entity extraction, entity resolution, semantic search, prompt engineering, LLM grounding, and enterprise\-scale LLM applications.
   

  

 Ability to design and implement scalable graph ingestion, ontology/schema pipelines, semantic layers, vector search/retrieval patterns, RAG pipelines, and governed knowledge services.
   

  

 Strong collaboration, technical leadership, delivery ownership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, with Azure specialization and exposure to AWS or GCP in multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, or related credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, manufacturing, energy, public sector, or life sciences, including domain ontologies, data models, compliance needs, and knowledge\-driven use cases.
   

  

 External client\-facing consulting experience, proposal support, solution shaping, or pre\-sales exposure.
   

  

 Advanced degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline broad exposure to diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.

title: AI Generalist
description:
**Experience:** 
  2\-3 years
 



  





**About Riverfront** 




 Riverfront is independent behavioral validation for AI agents. We test agents through their real interface, the way a user or regulator would, and produce evidence that boards, auditors, and regulators can rely on. Our methodology is aligned to the frameworks regulators are writing (EU AI Act, GDPR, UAE PDPL, Colorado AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001\), and it's versioned end to end, so any result can be reproduced and defended months later.
 



  





  





 We work in a spec\-driven, AI\-orchestrated model where the quality of your thinking matters more than your typing speed. We're looking for people who can understand ambiguous problems, make sound technical decisions, and build.
 



  





**Location:** 
  Pune, India/Dubai, UAE
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will own complex problems from brief to delivery \- understanding the problem, turning it into a precise spec, making architectural decisions, building alongside the team, and shipping with confidence.
 



**This is a hands\-on engineering role with significant ownership.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 



* Turn complex product and client requirements into structured technical specs before development begins
* Architect and build agentic AI systems end to end \- including RAG pipelines, multi\-agent orchestration, MCP\-based integrations, tool\-use workflows, and memory
* Make architecture decisions across model selection, retrieval strategy, memory design, and orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, and AutoGen
* Own performance and cost trade\-offs across token usage, latency, inference quality, and LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, and AWS Bedrock
* Build observability and evaluation systems using tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Helicone, Arize, and W\&B
* Define evaluation criteria and determine what "good" actually means for an AI agent
* Contribute directly to Riverfront's AI governance and evaluation platform
* Participate in solution design, technical decisions, and product delivery
* Review other developers' work and identify weak assumptions or shallow planning early
* Join client and stakeholder conversations when needed and explain technical decisions clearly
* Help evolve the spec\-driven development practices the team uses as we scale



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**You have around 2\-3 years of hands\-on engineering experience** 
 , ideally in a product company, technical consultancy, startup, or agency where you have had real ownership.
 



 More importantly, you have 
 **shipped AI systems beyond the prototype stage** 
 .
 



 You should be comfortable with:
 


* Agentic and multi\-agent AI systems with real tool use and memory
* RAG pipelines and retrieval architecture
* Vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Qdrant, or Milvus
* Backend engineering \- APIs, microservices, asynchronous systems, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD
* Modern LLM providers and model\-selection trade\-offs
* AI\-assisted development using tools such as Claude Code or Cursor



 You have written specs or requirements documents, made architectural decisions, and stood behind them. You are comfortable working directly with product leadership, clients, or other stakeholders rather than operating only from a ticket queue.
 



 You ask difficult questions before you start building and document important decisions as you go.
 



**This role is for someone who wants to stay deeply hands\-on \- building, experimenting, making technical decisions, and owning outcomes. It is not designed as a short path into people management.** 









**What You'll Get** 



* Meaningful ownership from day one
* Direct involvement in product and technical decisions
* Work on AI systems that are actually being deployed and evaluated in production
* Exposure across agentic AI, AI governance, evaluation, and enterprise AI
* The opportunity to help shape both the product and the engineering practices behind it
* Competitive compensation based on experience and location

title: Principal  Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**Principal Engineer** 
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Principal Engineer**

 You will provide technical leadership while actively contributing to product development, architecture, and engineering excellence. This role combines software engineering, team leadership, product collaboration, and quality ownership to build a high\-performing engineering organization.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and mentor the Pune engineering and QA teams.

* Drive architecture decisions, code quality, security, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with global engineering and product teams to deliver product roadmap initiatives.
* Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Own engineering quality, testing strategy, and CI/CD standards.
* Build and grow the engineering team through hiring, coaching, and technical mentorship.
* Champion modern engineering practices, including AI\-assisted software development.


**Must Have**
* 12\+ years of software engineering experience with 5\+ years in a technical leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Java (Spring Boot) and good working knowledge of Go.
* Experience building distributed systems and microservices.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, messaging systems, databases, and system design.
* Experience leading engineering teams and mentoring developers.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and security best practices.
* Excellent communication skills and experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Experience using AI\-powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Industrial IoT, edge computing, or manufacturing software.
* Knowledge of MQTT, OPC\-UA, Modbus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ.
* Experience with AI/ML deployment at the edge.
* Familiarity with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, and observability platforms.
* Experience building Global Capability Centers or leading distributed engineering teams.


**Why Join Litmus?**
* Build next\-generation Industrial AI and Edge Computing products.
* Work on large\-scale distributed systems used by global manufacturers.
* Collaborate with highly experienced global engineering teams.
* Lead the growth of a strategic engineering team in Pune.
* Influence architecture, product direction, and engineering culture from day one.

title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
description:

 Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI\-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $9 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with nearly 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end\-to\-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, London, Edinburgh, Pune, Dubai, Geneva, Singapore and São Paulo.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player\-coach — guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission\-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production\-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions.
   

  

 You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite — from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white\-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI\-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people\-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward\-deployed delivery model with hands\-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high\-performing engineering team.
   

  

 Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
   

  

**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**What You’ll Do**
* Serve as a player\-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands\-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
* Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross\-functional partners
* Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
* Design and implement production\-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time\-to\-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
* Write and review production\-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value


**Who You Are**
* Experience: Minimum 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward\-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production\-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Data Platforms: Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large\-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Pipelines \& Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM\-driven automation solutions
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi\-asset class portfolios
* Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Leadership: A solutions\-driven, player\-coach mindset — able to balance hands\-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people\-management skills
* Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context\-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
* Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments while maintaining high\-quality standards


**Our Values**
* Act Like an Owner \- Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together \- Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients \- Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation \- Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning \- Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.


 In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
   

  

**What We Do…**
 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.
   

  

 We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
   

  

 And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 56,000 hotels in 150\+ countries \- with over 140 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
   

  

**About The Data Engineering Lead Role…**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to provide technical direction and people leadership for a small team of data engineers. You will help shape the evolution of SiteMinder’s cloud data platform while continuing to contribute directly to the design and delivery of data engineering solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on data engineering projects and 30% on Data Operations, reliability, and support. You will work across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering, product, finance, commercial, and analytics stakeholders to turn business needs into trusted, maintainable data solutions. You will also help establish the engineering standards, operating practices, and team capabilities needed to scale our data platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
**Technical leadership**
* Set technical direction for data engineering projects and make pragmatic architecture decisions
* Lead design reviews and establish reusable patterns for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data modelling, testing, deployment, and observability
* Promote engineering best practices across code quality, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, documentation, and operational readiness
* Guide the adoption and effective use of Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, and supporting platform technologies
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, data quality, and cost efficiency
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution to complex data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production issues


**People leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a small team of data engineers through regular feedback, goal\-setting, mentoring, and career development
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and capability planning for the team
* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
* Help team members make sound technical decisions while encouraging autonomy and accountability


**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**
* Own or contribute to the delivery of data engineering initiatives from discovery and design through implementation and production support
* Translate business and analytical requirements into robust data products and well\-defined delivery plans
* Build strong functional knowledge of SiteMinder’s systems and business processes, including applications such as Salesforce and Zuora
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Participate in data discovery, deep\-dive analysis, and investigation of complex data issues, communicating findings and recommended actions clearly


**Data Operations and reliability**
* Help operate and support production data pipelines, datasets, and integrations within agreed service levels.
* Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-management practices.
* Improve data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and documentation.
* Manage operational requests and prioritise ad hoc analysis based on business impact and urgency.
* Identify recurring operational issues and convert them into sustainable engineering improvements rather than manual workarounds


**What You Have…**
**Technical Experience**
* Significant professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading technical delivery or mentoring engineers
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms, including Databricks and/or Snowflake, and production experience with dbt
* Experience designing and implementing data platforms using medallion or comparable layered architecture patterns
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience writing, testing, debugging, and optimising production data pipelines
* Experience with data modelling, dimensional modelling, data warehousing, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data products
* Experience building and operating complete ETL or ELT processes, including ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
* Practical experience with Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code approach
* Experience building bespoke integrations using Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of data reliability, observability, security, access control, and cost management
* Experience working with AWS data services and the ability to choose appropriate services for a given use case


**Leadership and collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, make clear technical decisions, and create alignment across teams
* Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across a team
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* A structured and analytical approach to problem\-solving, with sound judgment when working independently
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams
* A practical, delivery\-focused mindset suited to a growing technology organisation


**Nice to have**
* Experience with streaming or event\-driven data platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with AWS services such as Glue, EMR, and Kinesis
* Experience with Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing
* Experience with change data capture, near\-real\-time ingestion, or integration with OLTP systems
* Experience with data governance, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, or master data concepts
* Experience supporting a migration between data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience in the SaaS, travel, hospitality, or marketplace sectors


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity practices for operational technology, industrial networks, edge devices, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Experience supporting regulated, mission\-critical, or high\-availability customer environments.
* Experience with pre\-sales architecture, technical discovery, proposal approval, statement\-of\-work review, RFI/RFP responses, and commercial scope validation.
* Experience working with systems integrators, channel partners, value\-added resellers, and regional technology partners.
* Experience contributing to product roadmaps, design reviews, beta programs, technical validation, or release\-readiness processes.
* Experience developing technical standards, reference architectures, implementation methodologies, and reusable engineering assets.
* Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, cybersecurity, industrial automation, or solution architecture.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, automation, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


**Measures of Success**
* Quality, consistency, and scalability of APAC customer implementations.
* Successful delivery of strategic proof\-of\-concept and production engagements.
* Reduction in implementation risk, technical rework, escalations, and recurring support issues.
* Timeliness and quality of regional technical decisions and approvals.
* Customer adoption, value realization, satisfaction, and expansion.
* Development and technical readiness of Application Engineers.
* Adoption of regional and global delivery standards, reusable assets, and best practices.
* Effectiveness of pre\-sales\-to\-delivery handovers and technical scope validation.
* Quality and influence of APAC field feedback provided to Product Management and Development.
* Ability to balance customer priorities, team capacity, delivery commitments, and long\-term technical quality.


**Reports To:** 
 Manager, Customer Success Operations
   

  

**Global Technical Alignment:** 
 Director of Technical Delivery
   

  

**Regional Scope:** 
 APAC

description:
**Job Description**
**Position / Group description:**

 Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. **IT Risk Technology**
 Risk Technology is a global, cross functional team responsible for enterprise risk platforms at Jefferies. The team works closely with Risk Management and Trading to identify, measure, and manage risk across the firm. It designs, implements, and supports largescale, data intensive systems that facilitate risk data management, advanced analytics, visualization, analysis, and reporting across various asset classes.
   

  

 The India Risk Technology team is a strategic part of the global organization. Team members in India participate in the full lifecycle of the risk platform development — from design and engineering through enhancement and support — and take ownership of critical systems used by risk managers and senior leadership worldwide.
   

  

 As Jefferies continues to modernize and expand its risk ecosystem, Risk Technology is building the next generation risk platform using cloud native architectures, distributed compute, containers, modern data platforms, advanced BI, and applied AI. Risk Technology plays a critical role in enabling informed decision making, strengthening firmwide controls, and supporting sustainable growth in an increasingly complex and dynamic market environment.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands‑on
 **Developer** 
 to build and operate risk dashboards and reports leveraging Astrato’s direct\-query connection to a Snowflake database containing all required risk and static data needed to produce the firm’s risk. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of
 **data modeling** 
 and
 **business intelligence fundamentals \& concepts** 
 , and can optimize performance, reliability, and compute costs.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and support scalable dashboards leveraging Astrato’s direct\-query capabilities integrated with Snowflake data warehouses
* Optimize data models to normalize data to fit reporting needs, optimizing for performance to deliver accurate risk results in the least possible time
* Support existing reporting solutions in production to ensure timely daily delivery of reports and dashboarding refreshes as defined by SLAs
* Investigate platform issues reported by risk management and daily operational teams
* Collaborate with other internal IT teams to ensure a seamless end\-to\-end process for delivering risk reports.


**Essential Experience/ Skills**
* Data modelling and dashboard development experience, ideally using direct\-query BI products, such as Sigma and Tableau.
* Snowflake SQL expertise.
* Experience building and supporting risk management reports for one or more of the following asset classes (in order of importance) equities, fixed income, credit, FX \& commodities
* Understanding of cash and derivative products and the risk measures for each i.e. delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho etc.
* Understanding of the market data required to generate risk i.e. yield curves, volatility surfaces, credit curves, correlation matrices, spot fx etc
* Understanding of VAR, historical PNL vector generation, PNL generation, PNL attribution, custom risk scenarios etc
* CI/CD and change management process.
* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or similar technical discipline

* Team player with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex reporting or data issues

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SDE III, you'll bring your engineering depth into a new way of working. You won't just write code — you'll specify, orchestrate, validate, and ship with AI as your primary collaborator. You'll work in a small, mission\-driven cross\-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand\-offs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Tech Lead, you'll join the Product \& Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how software gets built in an AI Native setup?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Deliver against the pod's mission — own the full software delivery lifecycle including quality, from design through production and measurement.
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — pull work, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Use AI agents as your primary delivery mechanism — code generation, testing, spec writing, deployment.
* Design, build, and debug software across backend and frontend with distributed systems awareness.
* Evaluate and tune agent workflows — steering docs, prompts, rules, skills. You improve the tools you use.
* Write clean, well\-tested code and take ownership of quality end\-to\-end.
* Act as the initial on\-call responder, ensuring health and stability of deployed applications.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to shared tooling, knowledge bases, and the agent foundation kit.


 Engineering Mindset — What We Look For
   

  

**We Assess Every Candidate Across Six Core Dimensions**
* AI Fluency: AI is the primary way we engineer. Prompt, evaluate, and iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* Cross\-Functional Versatility: “That’s not my area” doesn’t exist. Contribute beyond your discipline, share knowledge openly, and communicate clearly across different formats.
* Customer and Value Awareness: Ask “why” and “for whom” before “how.” Understand the bigger business context while still being able to zoom in and trace a bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* Craft: Apply SOLID principles, DRY, separation of concerns, and observability by default. Write clean, maintainable code with the right level of testing. Treat CI/CD as standard engineering practice, whether the code is written by a human or an AI agent.
* Technical Curiosity: Build a prototype, experiment, and try to break it before relying solely on documentation. Stay curious about how things work and continuously explore better approaches.
* Agency \& Entrepreneurship: Don’t wait for permission. Take ownership of outcomes end\-to\-end, enable others to succeed, challenge the status quo, and proactively look for ways to create value.


**Qualifications**
* Strong proficiency in at least one of the following: Java/Spring Boot, Python, .NET, Go, or Angular, with the ability to learn and work with other technologies using AI.
* Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, data structures, API design, database concepts, and cloud computing.
* Experience with clean code practices, TDD, CI/CD, and version control.
* Experience with application monitoring, observability, and production debugging.
* Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Proficiency in using AI\-assisted development tools for code generation, pair programming, and automated testing.
* Experience with agent systems, MCP/tool protocols, or building AI\-augmented workflows.
* Experience designing evaluation and observability strategies for AI\-generated outputs.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to shared tooling, internal platforms, or open\-source projects.
* Background in industries with strict regulatory requirements, such as gaming, financial services, or healthcare.


**Additional Information**
 At Entain India, we offer a strong package and the support people need to make an impact. Join us, and a great compensation package is just the beginning. You can expect to receive benefits like:
   

  

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
